reason: A Windows Electron desktop client that manages a local Harness gateway and presents its official web UI with tray residency, configuration, logging, and optional login startup.

summaries.zh: 一个通过托盘和可选开机自启管理本地 Harness 网关，并在 Electron 窗口中嵌入官方 Web 界面的桌面客户端。
summaries.en: A desktop client that manages a local Harness gateway through tray controls and optional login startup while embedding the official web interface in an Electron window.

capabilities: Starts or reuses a local Harness gateway process
Embeds the Harness web interface in an Electron window
Runs in the system tray after the window is closed
Supports optional launch at user login
Writes gateway logs and settings to the local userData directory
